data.name: Sachana
data.gender_notes: Sachana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sachana is a Hindu name that means 'Dawn' or 'Goddess of Prosperity'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sach-' meaning 'truth' and '-ana' meaning 'dawn'. This name is associated with the goddess of the same name, who is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune. The name Sachana carries the meaning “Dawn, Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sachana usually hope their child will grow to embody dawn, goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sachana is a name of the Hindu goddess of dawn and prosperity. It is believed that she brings new beginnings and prosperity. She is also associated with the god Vishnu and the goddess Lakshmi.
data.etymology: Sachana belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dawn, Goddess of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sachana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
